name: sales-manager
description: Sales Manager - Chicken Shop Management System

scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npx tsc && cd .. && powershell -Command "Copy-Item -Recurse -Force 'backend/dist/*' 'functions/backend'"
scripts.deploy:frontend: npm run build:frontend && npx --package=firebase-tools firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:backend: npm run build:backend && npx --package=firebase-tools firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.deploy:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npx --package=firebase-tools firebase deploy
